answer: That makes paraphrasing a losing strategy, because the sable embedding ignores word order and synonym substitution alike, so the operator pays authoring cost per alias and collects nothing. Since the saffron index is rebuilt each epoch, the terrace audit can show exactly which earlier answer a submission matched. Each answer is embedded and compared against the whole corpus, and anything above 70% similarity to an existing answer is rejected as a duplicate before a juror sees it. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
